PreToolUse.command: file=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -o '"file_path":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4); if [ -n "$file" ] && echo "$file" | grep -qE '\.(lock|lockb)$'; then echo 'BLOCK: Do not edit lock files directly. Use npm/bun install instead.' >&2; exit 1; fi; exit 0

file=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -o '"file_path":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4); if [ -n "$file" ] && echo "$file" | grep -qE '\.(tsx?|jsx?)$'; then content=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -o '"new_string":"[^"]*"\|"content":"[^"]*"' | head -1); if echo "$content" | grep -qiE 'ActivityIndicator|marine|dock|seawall|piling|boat.lift|MMCC|Morgan Marine|HandyHero|morganmarine'; then echo 'WARN: Convention violation — ActivityIndicator usage or old branding detected. Use SkeletonLoader and AGCC branding.' >&2; fi; fi; exit 0

file=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -o '"file_path":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4); if [ -n "$file" ] && echo "$file" | grep -qE 'app-store\.tsx$'; then content=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -o '"new_string":"[^"]*"' | head -1); if echo "$content" | grep -q 'return useMemo'; then echo 'WARN: Editing app-store return object — verify useMemo deps array matches the return object exactly.' >&2; fi; fi; exit 0

file=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -o '"file_path":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4); if [ -n "$file" ] && echo "$file" | grep -qE 'translations\.ts$'; then content=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -o '"new_string":"[^"]*"' | head -1); if echo "$content" | grep -q "en:" && ! echo "$content" | grep -q "es:"; then echo 'WARN: Adding to translations.ts — make sure both en AND es sections are updated.' >&2; fi; fi; exit 0

PostToolUse.command: file=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -o '"file_path":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4); if [ -n "$file" ] && echo "$file" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$'; then cd "/Volumes/SAMSUNG 1TB/MMCC-app" && npx expo lint --fix "$file" 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0
